report_metadata.assessment: Kapstone AI/ML Developer Intern Technical Assessment
report_metadata.disclaimer: This report is generated automatically for assessment purposes. Detections are model-based probabilities, NOT confirmed incidents. All findings require human investigation before action is taken. Compliance mappings are indicative, not a formal audit.

dataset_and_methodology.source: University of New South Wales Canberra Cyber Range Lab
limitations: srcip, dstip, and timestamps absent from Kaggle CSVs; IP-based correlation uses placeholders.
Time-window correlation requires real timestamps not present in this CSV split.
Model trained on network flow data; real deployment needs retraining on live traffic.
False positives and negatives are inherent; human validation required for all findings.

model_evaluation.fp_explanation: False positives (normal traffic classified as attack) increase alert fatigue. Mitigation: tune threshold, add whitelist rules, collect more normal traffic.
model_evaluation.fn_explanation: False negatives (attacks missed by model) are the more dangerous error type. Mitigation: diversify training data, use ensemble approaches, add rule-based detection.

compliance_frameworks.rationale: DoS attacks target service availability. PR.DS-4 requires capacity management to maintain availability.
ISO 27001 A.8.6 requires monitoring and managing resource capacity to prevent availability degradation from volumetric attacks.

remediation: Implement rate limiting, traffic scrubbing, and CDN-based DDoS mitigation.

Systematic scanning violates expected use; monitoring activities detects such behaviour.

remediation: Block scanning IPs, deploy honeypots, enable intrusion detection signatures.
